pre_condition: proj_dir is a valid directory path. lang_keys is a collection of language key strings recognized by CodeGraph.
post_condition: Returns a dict mapping each normalized relative file path string to a dict of {function_identifier: function_source_text} for all files under proj_dir whose language matches any key in lang_keys and whose functions are indexed by CodeGraph. Function identifiers use class-qualified names for C++ methods. If no usable CodeGraph index is available at proj_dir, returns None.
